compute.cost_note: one spaCy tagging pass per target and comparator file; no model download beyond en_core_web_sm

do_not_use_when: you want word-level repetition (use repetition_audit or manuscript_repetition_audit)
you are comparing two whole corpora rather than one document (use manuscript_bigram_diff)
you want an AI/human verdict; a bigram contribution is a revision cue, not evidence of provenance

examples.description: Top divergent POS bigrams of a draft against comparators

inputs.target: one .txt/.md target plus comparator files (--cluster-dir or --cluster-files)

artifacts: Markdown table of top divergent POS bigrams with examples (stdout or --out)

purpose: Per-bigram POS-bigram diff of one target document against a cluster of comparator documents. Ranks the spaCy POS bigrams by their contribution to the divergence (cluster mean, pooled, or both), with example token pairs, so a variance_audit POS-bigram KL elevation can be traced to the specific syntactic templates driving it.
use_when: variance_audit flagged elevated POS-bigram KL/JSD against a baseline and you want to know which bigrams drive it
preparing a metric-targeted restoration packet (restoration_packet reads this JSON)
comparing one draft against a small set of the writer's own comparator texts
